title: PBMCs, CTRL-1
extract_protocol_ch1: GEM generation and barcoding, POST GEM RT cleanup and cDNA amplification, 3' gene library construction
3' gene expression
data_processing: scRNA-seq feature count matrices were constructed using Cell Ranger (v7.1.0), aligning reads to 165 the GRCh38 2020 reference genome. Subsequent quality control and data processing were performed with 166 the Seurat package (v4.3.0)

Assembly: Cells with less than 200 detected genes were discarded, as well as cells with more than 15% mitochondrial genes. DropletUtils (v1.14.2) identified empty droplets, while doublets were detected using Scrublet (v0.2.3-0). DecontX was used to detect ambient RNA contamination. Subsequently, we excluded identified empty droplets, doublets, and those with a contamination score above 0.2, alongside cells with more than 9 UMIs mapping to the hemoglobin subunit beta (HBB) gene (representing red blood cells) for further analysis. For cell type annotation, we used SCTransform for data normalization and identification of variable features. This was followed by principal component analysis (PCA) and batch effect correction using Harmony. Graph-based clustering and UMAP embedding were generated based on Harmony embeddings. Cell types were assigned to each cluster guided by canonical marker gene expression. For cell type proportions analysis, we normalized the number of cells within a given cell type by the total number of cells per subject. For Differentially Expressed Gene (DEG) analysis, we used the Seurat software (v4.3.0) “FindMarkers" function to identify differentially expressed DEGs across disease groups.
Supplementary files format and content: Tab separated values and matrix files (samples Clinic-10 and Clinic-13 not analyzed due to sample quality issues)

data_processing: scRNA-seq feature count matrices were constructed using Cell Ranger (v7.1.0), aligning reads to 165 the GRCh38 2020 reference genome. Subsequent quality control and data processing were performed with 166 the Seurat package (v4.3.0)

Assembly: Cells with less than 200 detected genes were discarded, as well as cells with more than 15% mitochondrial genes. DropletUtils (v1.14.2) identified empty droplets, while doublets were detected using Scrublet (v0.2.3-0). DecontX was used to detect ambient RNA contamination. Subsequently, we excluded identified empty droplets, doublets, and those with a contamination score above 0.2, alongside cells with more than 9 UMIs mapping to the hemoglobin subunit beta (HBB) gene (representing red blood cells) for further analysis. For cell type annotation, we used SCTransform for data normalization and identification of variable features. This was followed by principal component analysis (PCA) and batch effect correction using Harmony. Graph-based clustering and UMAP embedding were generated based on Harmony embeddings. Cell types were assigned to each cluster guided by canonical marker gene expression. For cell type proportions analysis, we normalized the number of cells within a given cell type by the total number of cells per subject. For Differentially Expressed Gene (DEG) analysis, we used the Seurat software (v4.3.0) “FindMarkers" function to identify differentially expressed DEGs across disease groups.
Supplementary files format and content: Tab separated values and matrix files (samples Clinic-10 and Clinic-13 not analyzed due to sample quality issues)
